switcher.label: Switch shop, current shop {name}
switcher.heading: Your shops
overview.suspension.fulfill_existing: Existing orders can still be fulfilled.
overview.suspension.frozen: The shop is frozen. DripNepal handles its open orders.
overview.checklist.heading: Before you can sell
overview.checklist.intro: What your shop has in place so far. More steps appear here as the seller pages are added.
overview.checklist.product_live: A product live in your shop
products.heading: Products
products.intro: Every product of your shop. Open one to change its details; customers see only published products.
products.column.title: Product
products.search_help: The start of a title or SKU.
products.shown: {count, plural, one {# product shown} other {# products shown}}
products.empty_body: Start with a draft: its details first, then variants, stock and photos. Customers see nothing until it is published.
products.empty_body_read_only: This shop has no products yet.
product_new.heading: Add a product
product_new.intro: Save a draft first. Its page then takes the variants, stock and photos.
product.rejected_no_reason: DripNepal asked for changes without giving a reason.
product.rejected_help: Saving any change returns the product to draft.
product.read_only_role: Your role can see products but not change them. Ask the shop's owner.
product.read_only_shop: While the shop is suspended, its products can't be changed.
product.read_only_review: This product is in review. It can be changed again once the review ends.
product.read_only_archived: This product is archived, so it can't be changed.
product.read_only_blocked: DripNepal blocked this product, so it can't be changed.
product.title: Title
product.title_help: Up to {max} characters. Customers see this first.
product.title_rule: Write a title of {min} to {max} characters.
product.category_help: The most specific category that fits. It decides which attributes and sizes the product has.
product.brand_help: The brand it is sold under, or your own label. Missing a brand? Ask support to add it.
product.brand_help_moderated: The brand it is sold under, or your own label. DripNepal reviews products of this brand before they go live.
product.attributes_help: What the category asks about this product. Customers filter by some of these.
product.attributes_unused: This product still has values for {names}, which its category no longer uses. Saving the details removes them; the product can’t go live with them.
product.attributes_none: This category asks for no attributes.
product.attributes_first: Choose a category to see its attributes.
product.attribute_required: Needed before the product can go live.
product.listing_help_draft: The law asks every listing to show these. A draft may leave them empty, but each is needed before the product can go live.
product.listing_help_live: The law asks every listing to show these, so a live product keeps each one filled in.
product.description_help: What it is, how it fits and what it is made of. Up to {max} characters.
product.manufacturer_name_help: The maker who produced it, or the brand owner.
product.country_help: The country the product was made in.
product.care_help: How to wash or look after it, and any precautions in use.
product.live_required: A live product must keep this filled in.
product.conflict_body: Someone saved this product after you opened this page. Your entries are still in the form.
product.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
product.missing.heading: Before this product can go live
product.missing.warranty_text: Give the warranty, or say there is none.
product.missing.country_of_origin: Choose the country it is imported from.
product.missing.shipping: Set where you deliver and your delivery rates.
product.missing.refused: It was not published. Fix these, then publish again.
product.move.archive_consequence: It leaves your shop, and its variants are archived, which frees their SKUs. Restoring it brings it back as a draft whose variants you set again.
product.move.save_first: Save or undo your changes first: publishing, hiding and archiving use the product as saved.
product.move.needs_review: This product has to be reviewed before it can go live, and review isn’t offered yet. Ask DripNepal support.
product.variants.heading: Variants
product.variants.intro: Each size or colour you sell, with its SKU, price and the stock you hold.
product.variants.options_help: Choose up to {max} options, such as size and colour. Leave them all unticked for a product with one variant.
product.variants.options_locked: These options are fixed: a variant has been stocked or sold. You can still add or remove values.
product.variants.no_options: This category has no options, so the product has one variant.
product.variants.grid_help_draft: One row for each combination. A draft may keep a price of 0 for now; every price must be above 0 before the product can go live.
product.variants.grid_help_live: One row for each combination. A live product's prices must stay above 0.
product.variants.choose_values: Choose at least one value for each option to see its variants.
product.variants.has_history: Stocked or sold, so its options stay as they are.
product.variants.archived_help: Kept for their stock and order history. Choose a variant's options above to sell it again.
product.variants.sku_invalid: Use up to {max} letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores or slashes, starting with a letter or digit.
product.variants.price_invalid: Write an amount in rupees up to {max_price}, such as 1299 or 1299.50.
product.variants.price_positive: A live product needs a price above 0.
product.variants.compare_at_invalid: Write an amount in rupees up to {max_price}, or leave it empty.
product.variants.compare_at_not_above: The earlier price must be above the price.
product.variants.weight_invalid: Write whole grams from {min_weight} to {max_weight}, or leave it empty.
product.variants.too_many: Choose fewer values: a product has at most {max} variants.
product.variants.no_rows: Choose a value that can be sold: a retired value stays only on a variant that already has it.
product.variants.required_axis: A live product in this category needs its required options.
product.variants.no_values: Choose at least one value for each option.
product.variants.conflict_body: Someone saved this product after you opened this page. Your variants are still in the form.
product.variants.conflict_variants: The variants, their SKUs or prices
product.variants.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
stock.heading: Stock
stock.intro: What you hold of each variant. Reserved units are held for orders; customers can buy only what is available.
stock.empty_body: Stock is kept per variant. Add a product and its variants first.
stock.no_variants: This product has no active variants. Add variants to it to track stock.
stock.count_description: {label}: enter how many you counted. On hand is set to your count.
stock.count_changed: Stock changed to {on_hand} while you counted. Check your count, then save again.
stock.counted_help: Units you hold now, reserved ones included.
stock.below_zero: You can’t set stock to {target}: it can’t go below zero.
stock.reserved_for_orders: You can’t set stock to {target}: {reserved, plural, one {# unit is} other {# units are}} reserved for open orders{orders}.
stock.reserved_for_payment: You can’t set stock to {target}: {reserved, plural, one {# unit is} other {# units are}} reserved for a payment in progress, which is released automatically if the payment does not complete.
stock.reserved_split: You can’t set stock to {target}: {reserved} units are reserved, {committed} for open orders{orders} and {held} for a payment in progress, which is released automatically if the payment does not complete.
shipping.heading: Shipping
shipping.intro: Where the shop delivers, what delivery costs, how long it takes, and where the courier collects parcels.
shipping.configured: Shipping is set up: the shop delivers to at least one district and every zone it delivers to has a rate.
shipping.not_configured: Shipping is not set up yet. Choose the districts you deliver to and give each of their zones a fee and a delivery time. Products can't be published until then.
shipping.read_only_role: Your role can see the delivery settings but not change them. Ask the shop's owner or a manager.
shipping.read_only_status: While the shop is suspended, its delivery settings can't be changed.
shipping.coverage_help: Customers in other districts can't order from the shop.
shipping.coverage_required: Choose at least one district, or tick “Deliver to every district”.
shipping.rates_help: The fee for one parcel and how long delivery takes, for each zone. Customers see both before they order.
shipping.zone_covered: {count, plural, one {You deliver to # district in this zone, so it needs a rate.} other {You deliver to # districts in this zone, so it needs a rate.}}
shipping.zone_not_covered: You don't deliver to this zone. A rate is optional: leave all three empty for none.
shipping.fee_help: In rupees, like 150 or 150.50. 0 means free delivery.
shipping.fee_required: Enter the fee for {zone}, or 0 for free delivery.
shipping.fee_rule: Enter the fee in rupees, like 150 or 150.50.
shipping.min_days_required: Enter the fastest delivery time for {zone}, in days.
shipping.max_days_required: Enter the slowest delivery time for {zone}, in days.
shipping.days_rule: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to {max}.
shipping.max_before_min: The slowest time can't be shorter than the fastest.
shipping.rate_summary: {fee} per parcel, {min} to {max, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
shipping.conflict_body: Someone saved changes to this shop after you opened this page. Your entries are still in the form.
shipping.conflict_elsewhere: The delivery settings themselves did not change: the change was to the shop's other settings.
shipping.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
shipping.pickup.heading: Pickup addresses
shipping.pickup.intro: Where the courier collects your parcels. The default address is offered first when you book a parcel.
shipping.pickup.empty_body: Add the place the courier collects parcels from. The first one becomes the default.
shipping.pickup.default_note: The shop always keeps a default pickup address. To remove this one, make another the default first.
shipping.pickup.remove_consequence: {title} is no longer offered for new bookings. Parcels already booked from it keep it.
shipping.pickup.now_default: {title} is now the default pickup address.
shipping.pickup.label: Label (optional)
shipping.pickup.label_help: Like Workshop or Warehouse, up to {max} characters.
shipping.pickup.label_rule: Use up to {max} characters for the label.
shipping.pickup.contact_name_help: The person the courier asks for.
shipping.pickup.contact_name_rule: Enter the contact person's name, {min} to {max} characters.
shipping.pickup.contact_phone_help: The courier calls this number. A mobile number, or a landline with its area code, like 01-4123456.
shipping.pickup.contact_phone_rule: Enter a Nepali mobile number, or a landline with its area code, like 01-4123456.
shipping.pickup.local_level_help: The metropolitan city, sub-metropolitan city, municipality or rural municipality.
shipping.pickup.local_level_retired: This local level is no longer offered. The address keeps it until you choose another one, which also lets you change the ward.
shipping.pickup.area_tole_rule: Enter the area or tole, {min} to {max} characters.
shipping.pickup.street_landmark_help: A nearby landmark helps the courier find the place.
shipping.pickup.street_landmark_rule: Use up to {max} characters for the street or landmark.
shipping.pickup.is_default: Make this the default pickup address
shipping.pickup.is_default_help: The default is offered first when you book a parcel.
shipping.pickup.unchanged: Nothing has changed, so there is nothing to save.
settings.heading: Shop settings
settings.intro: The shop's profile and contact details.
settings.read_only_role: Your role can see these settings but not change them. Ask the shop's owner.
settings.read_only_status: While the shop is suspended, its settings can't be changed.
settings.name: Shop name
settings.name_help: The name and web address are set when the shop is created and can't be changed here.
settings.description_help: A few words about the shop, up to {max} characters.
settings.description_rule: Keep the description to {max} characters or fewer.
settings.contact_help: The shop's own address. Enter it separately from your personal email.
settings.contact_email_rule: Enter the shop's email address, like name@example.com.
settings.phone_help: A mobile number, or a landline with its area code, like 01-4123456.
settings.phone_rule: Enter a Nepali mobile number, or a landline with its area code, like 01-4123456.
settings.owner_only_help: Only the shop's owner can see and change these details in the seller pages.
settings.business_type_help: A registered business also gives its registration number and registering authority.
settings.registration_number_rule: Enter the registration number, up to {max} characters.
settings.registration_authority_help: The office that registered the business, like the Office of the Company Registrar.
settings.registration_authority_rule: Enter the registering authority, {min} to {max} characters.
settings.pan_help_required: 9 digits. A registered or VAT-registered business needs it.
settings.pan_help_optional: 9 digits. Optional for an individual who is not registered for VAT.
settings.pan_rule: Enter the 9 digits of the PAN/VAT number.
settings.pan_required: Enter the 9-digit PAN/VAT number. A registered or VAT-registered business needs it.
settings.is_vat_registered: The shop is registered for VAT
settings.is_vat_registered_help: A VAT-registered shop needs its PAN/VAT number.
settings.return_policy_help: The shop's return terms, up to {max} characters.
settings.return_policy_rule: Enter the return policy, up to {max} characters.
settings.grievance_help: The person who handles complaints about the shop. Only the shop's owner can see and change it in the seller pages.
settings.grievance_name_rule: Enter the contact's name, {min} to {max} characters.
settings.owner_only_note: The business details, return policy and grievance contact are shown to the shop's owner only.
settings.conflict_body: Someone saved the shop's settings after you opened this page. Your entries are still in the form.
settings.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
